name: LORA
description: Lora is a highly popular and versatile compendium card game from the Balkans (Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia, and Montenegro). Played with a 32-card German-suited or French deck by four players, it consists of a series of rounds, most of which are 'Negative' games (avoidance) where players aim to avoid winning specific cards or tricks. It is famous for its 'all-or-nothing' nature and is a staple of cafe social life in Southeast Europe.

content.text: Lora is a highly popular and versatile compendium card game from the Balkans (Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia, and Montenegro). Played with a 32-card German-suited or French deck by four players, it consists of a series of rounds, most of which are 'Negative' games (avoidance) where players aim to avoid winning specific cards or tricks. It is famous for its 'all-or-nothing' nature and is a staple of cafe social life in Southeast Europe.
Descended from the European 'King' or 'Barbu' family of compendium games, it was localized in Yugoslavia in the 20th century.
32 cards. French (Sh/Dl/Cl/Sp) or German (Acorns/Leaves/Hearts/Bells). Ace is high.

items.text: King: The French version with different point weights.
Herzn: German variant focused solely on Hearts.
